title: Admin View Vendor Lists by Status - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Comprehensive accessibility test plan for Admin Vendor Lists filtered by status (Pending Approval, Active Partners, Inactive Partners, Rejected Partners). Covers WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for status tabs, vendor cards, tab counts, empty states, auto-refresh, and responsive design.

testCases.title: Page has proper heading structure
testCases.wcagCriterion: 2.4.6 Headings and Labels, 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
testCases.preconditions: Admin is logged in and on Vendor Lists page
steps: 2. Verify H1 exists for page title
3. Use screen reader heading navigation (H key)
4. Verify heading hierarchy logical (no skipped levels)
expectedResults: Page has exactly one H1 heading
Screen reader can navigate by headings

testCases.title: Page has proper landmarks
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page

testCases.title: Status tabs have proper ARIA tablist pattern
testCases.componentElement: Status tabs (Pending Approval, Active, Inactive, Rejected)
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page
steps: 7. Verify aria-controls links tab to panel

testCases.title: Status tabs keyboard accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page
steps: 2. Verify focus lands on active tab
3. Press Right Arrow to move to next tab
4. Verify focus moves and tab activates
5. Press Left Arrow to move back
6. Verify Home key moves to first tab
7. Verify End key moves to last tab
8. Verify focus indicator visible on each tab
expectedResults: Tabs keyboard accessible via Tab key

testCases.title: Tab counts visible and announced
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page with vendors in various statuses
steps: 1. Verify each tab displays vendor count
2. Verify count is part of tab accessible name
3. Use screen reader — verify announces 'Pending Approval (5)' or similar
5. Verify count updates when vendors change status
expectedResults: Screen reader announces tab name with count

testCases.title: Tab switch announces content update
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page
steps: 2. Verify content updates without page reload
3. Verify aria-live region announces result count
4. Verify focus management after tab switch
5. Verify screen reader announces new content
expectedResults: Content updates dynamically on tab switch
Screen reader announces new vendor list

testCases.title: Vendor card has semantic structure
testCases.wcagCriterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 4.1.2 Name Role Value
testCases.componentElement: Vendor card (name, type, location, contact, product count)
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page with vendors displayed
steps: 2. Verify card has semantic structure (article, section, or aria-label)
3. Verify vendor name is a heading or has prominent role
8. Use screen reader to navigate card content
expectedResults: Vendor name announced as heading or prominent text

testCases.title: Vendor card keyboard accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page with vendors displayed
steps: 2. If cards are clickable, verify focus indicator visible
3. If cards have action buttons, verify buttons keyboard accessible
4. Verify tab order logical within and between cards
5. Verify Enter/Space activates card or buttons

testCases.title: Vendor type not conveyed by color alone
testCases.componentElement: Vendor type indicators (Manufacturer, Distributor, Service Provider)
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page with various vendor types
steps: 1. Review vendor type indicators on cards
2. Verify type conveyed by text label (not just color/icon)
3. Test in grayscale mode — verify types distinguishable

testCases.title: Contact details accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page with vendor cards showing contact info
steps: 1. Locate contact details on vendor card
2. If email is a link, verify mailto: protocol
3. If phone is a link, verify tel: protocol
4. Verify links have descriptive accessible names
6. Use screen reader to verify contact announced
expectedResults: Screen reader announces contact info clearly

testCases.title: Empty state message accessible (no vendors in tab)
testCases.componentElement: Empty state message when no vendors in selected tab
testCases.preconditions: Admin selects a tab with no vendors
steps: 1. Select tab with no vendors (e.g., Rejected with 0 count)
4. Verify message announced by screen reader
5. Verify message has proper semantic structure
expectedResults: Empty state message visible and clear
Message announced via aria-live or role='status'

testCases.title: Auto-refresh or refresh prompt accessible
testCases.preconditions: Vendor status changes while admin is viewing the list
steps: 2. If auto-refresh: verify update announced via aria-live
3. If refresh prompt: verify prompt keyboard accessible
4. Verify refresh does not disrupt user focus
5. Verify no unexpected content changes without warning
expectedResults: Refresh prompt keyboard accessible if present
User focus not disrupted by refresh

testCases.title: Vendor list semantic structure
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page with vendors displayed
steps: 3. Verify each vendor card is <li> or role='listitem'
4. Use screen reader to verify list announced with count
expectedResults: Vendor list uses semantic list structure
Each card is a list item
Screen reader announces list with item count
List navigable with screen reader shortcuts

testCases.title: Text contrast meets WCAG AA
testCases.componentElement: All text elements on Vendor Lists page
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page

testCases.title: UI component contrast meets WCAG AA
testCases.componentElement: Card borders, tab indicators, focus indicators
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page

testCases.title: Page usable at 200% zoom
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page
steps: 5. Verify no text truncation or overlap

testCases.title: Mobile viewport accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page on mobile device

testCases.title: Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page
steps: 2. Verify focus indicator on each tab
3. Verify focus indicator on each card (if interactive)
4. Verify focus indicator on any action buttons
expectedResults: Focus indicator visible on all interactive elements
Focus not obscured by other elements

testCases.title: No keyboard traps
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page
steps: 1. Tab through all elements on page
2. Verify focus cycles through all interactive elements
4. Verify no element traps keyboard focus
5. Verify focus can reach browser chrome

testCases.title: NVDA screen reader compatibility
testCases.componentElement: Entire Vendor Lists page with NVDA
testCases.preconditions: NVDA screen reader enabled, Admin on Vendor Lists page
steps: 1. Navigate to Vendor Lists with NVDA
6. Switch tabs and verify content update announced

testCases.title: JAWS screen reader compatibility
testCases.componentElement: Entire Vendor Lists page with JAWS
testCases.preconditions: JAWS screen reader enabled, Admin on Vendor Lists page
steps: 1. Navigate to Vendor Lists with JAWS

testCases.title: Loading state accessible
testCases.componentElement: Loading indicator during tab switch or data fetch
testCases.preconditions: Admin switches tabs triggering data load
steps: 1. Switch to a different status tab
2. Verify loading indicator visible (if data takes time)
3. Verify loading state announced via aria-live
4. Verify loading does not trap keyboard focus
expectedResults: Loading indicator visible during data fetch
Loading state announced to screen readers
Keyboard focus not trapped during loading
